rows.template_label: 2M rows · 1 join · no group by · window · limit 100
rows.query_text:
with
    filtered as (
        select
            dim_customer_wl.customer_segment,
            fact_event.customer_id,
            fact_event.product_id,
            fact_event.amount
        from fact_event_s as fact_event
        inner join dim_customer_wl on fact_event.customer_id = dim_customer_wl.customer_id
        where cast(substr(fact_event.event_code, 3, 3) as integer)
            < 150
    ),

    ranked as (
        select
            filtered.*,
            row_number() over (
                partition by filtered.customer_id
                order by filtered.amount desc
            ) as amount_rank
        from filtered
    )

    select
        count(*) as query_rows,
        sum(amount) as amount_total,
        count(distinct product_id) as products,
        max(amount_rank) as deepest_rank
    from ranked
    limit 100
